text:
maria: Heads-up — mobile clients hitting 413 on /v1/embeddings when they send mixed-dim batches (~20KB). Repro attached as curl.
kevin: Ugh, we added a preflight soft-limit for bytes last week. Can you paste the actual payload shape?
maria: payload snippet:\n```
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
body: {\n  inputs: [ { input: '...', dim: 1536 }, { input: '...', dim: 384 } , ... ]\n}
```
samir: That's the problem — current splitter is byte-first so it slices across vectors, producing padded mixes that break downstream runtime assumptions. Proposal: prefer dim-aware split (group by dim) then fallback to bytes for large single-dim arrays.
olivia: Telemetry from last 48h: ~5% of embed requests hit the splitter, ~0.3% end up 413 after client retries. The console dashboard only surfaces bytes/requests, not split-count or dim-mismatch rate.
kevin: Implementation plan: add routing flag `embed.split_strategy` with values ["bytes", "dim_then_bytes"], default = "bytes". Expose a console toggle for gradual rollout. Need metrics: `splitter.success_rate`, `splitter.avg_splits`, `splitter.dim_group_failures`.
maria: Also suggest SDK quick-fail: return 400 with `X-Embed-Expected-Dim: 1536` when a request mixes incompatible vectors instead of letting the server split and fail. Less latency for clients.
samir: For runtime safety, we should also add a compatibility check in the serving layer: if groups have >1 dim type and `split_strategy=dim_then_bytes` fails, fallback to rejecting with a clear error for SDKs to surface.
kevin: I'll draft a minimal config change. Example config diff:\n```
embed:
  split_strategy: dim_then_bytes
  max_bytes_soft: 16000
  enable_console_toggle: true
```
kevin: We'll canary the change behind the console toggle, 10% orgs first, watch `splitter.*` and `embed.413_rate`.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled to `eng-platform-canary` at 1719987800 by kevin.
maria: After canary, we should update the embed-console UI: add a small callout explaining why we split and show examples; also add an automatic suggestion to upgrade SDK when we return X-Embed-Expected-Dim.
olivia: I'll add the metrics to the preflight dashboard and wire up an alert if `splitter.dim_group_failures` > 0.1% for 15m.
samir: :thumbsup:
